source.title: 2026 Fantasy Football Rankings: Top 160 players for PPR drafts and redraft leagues
source.author: Dan Johnson
source.summary: A price-aware PPR top 160 with explicit target and fade tags plus short editorial notes.

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Gibbs combines elite rushing efficiency with 77-catch volume, giving him the cleanest overall ceiling even at a top-three price.
takeaways.rationale: Gibbs combines elite rushing efficiency with 77-catch volume, giving him the cleanest overall ceiling even at a top-three price.
risks: His acquisition cost leaves almost no room for merely good production.

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Taylor's league-leading rushing workload, efficiency, receiving growth, and goal-line control make a first-round slide especially attractive.
takeaways.rationale: Taylor's league-leading rushing workload, efficiency, receiving growth, and goal-line control make a first-round slide especially attractive.
risks: His value remains tied to maintaining an unusually heavy workload.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: McCaffrey's receiving floor remains elite, but 413 touches at age 29 plus recurring soft-tissue trouble make another top-six investment unusually fragile.
takeaways.rationale: McCaffrey's receiving floor remains elite, but 413 touches at age 29 plus recurring soft-tissue trouble make another top-six investment unusually fragile.
risks: He can still overcome the workload concern with unmatched receiving production.

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Bowers already earns wide-receiver-level route and target volume at fantasy's thinnest position, creating a weekly lineup advantage.
takeaways.rationale: Bowers already earns wide-receiver-level route and target volume at fantasy's thinnest position, creating a weekly lineup advantage.
risks: The Raiders' offensive ceiling can still limit touchdowns.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Nabers' exceptional target share and healthy-game production offer overall-WR1 volume at a price that already discounts his knee recovery.
takeaways.rationale: Nabers' exceptional target share and healthy-game production offer overall-WR1 volume at a price that already discounts his knee recovery.
risks: Medical recovery remains the central uncertainty.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Brown remains a proven alpha receiver and moves into an efficient New England passing game prepared to feed him substantial volume.
takeaways.rationale: Brown remains a proven alpha receiver and moves into an efficient New England passing game prepared to feed him substantial volume.
risks: Changing teams introduces role and chemistry uncertainty.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Waddle's elite per-route efficiency can finally pair with heavier volume after moving from a low-volume Miami offense to Denver.
takeaways.rationale: Waddle's elite per-route efficiency can finally pair with heavier volume after moving from a low-volume Miami offense to Denver.
risks: A new offense and quarterback create transition risk.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Jeanty's ankle sprain, low-efficiency rookie season, and weak scoring environment make his mid-second-round price demanding.
takeaways.rationale: Jeanty's ankle sprain, low-efficiency rookie season, and weak scoring environment make his mid-second-round price demanding.
risks: His dominant role can still overcome efficiency and team limitations.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Burden's late-season production and exceptional per-route command point to a larger role and meaningful upside beyond his crowded-depth-chart price.
takeaways.rationale: Burden's late-season production and exceptional per-route command point to a larger role and meaningful upside beyond his crowded-depth-chart price.
risks: The groin injury and target competition can delay the breakout.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Rice's short-area volume remains useful, but repeated availability problems make an early-fourth-round price difficult to trust.
takeaways.rationale: Rice's short-area volume remains useful, but repeated availability problems make an early-fourth-round price difficult to trust.
risks: Healthy games still carry a strong PPR floor.

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Tuten has access to a large vacant workload and valuable scoring opportunities in a productive backfield.
takeaways.rationale: Tuten has access to a large vacant workload and valuable scoring opportunities in a productive backfield.
risks: His rookie rushing efficiency was poor and the backfield may split more than expected.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Stevenson's larger playoff snap share and Henderson's pass-protection and ankle issues give him inexpensive access to a substantial role.
takeaways.rationale: Stevenson's larger playoff snap share and Henderson's pass-protection and ankle issues give him inexpensive access to a substantial role.
risks: Henderson can reclaim work when healthy and trusted.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Warren's solid rookie volume did not create elite efficiency or touchdown access, making a premium tight-end price hard to justify.
takeaways.rationale: Warren's solid rookie volume did not create elite efficiency or touchdown access, making a premium tight-end price hard to justify.
risks: Second-year growth could close the gap quickly.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Harrison's improving target control and touchdown production offer a post-hype discount on a young receiver with elite draft capital.
takeaways.rationale: Harrison's improving target control and touchdown production offer a post-hype discount on a young receiver with elite draft capital.
risks: Injuries and Arizona's passing environment have limited him through two seasons.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Judkins' weak efficiency and limited receiving production require too many improvements to justify his current fifth-round price.
takeaways.rationale: Judkins' weak efficiency and limited receiving production require too many improvements to justify his current fifth-round price.
risks: Goal-line volume can preserve weekly usefulness.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Warren's receiving role and ability to create yards protect his weekly floor while his price already accounts for early-down competition.
takeaways.rationale: Warren's receiving role and ability to create yards protect his weekly floor while his price already accounts for early-down competition.
risks: Rico Dowdle can cap carries and touchdown chances.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Washington's rare size-speed profile and immediate contingency role behind an injured Ashton Jeanty offer feature-back upside at a near-free price.
takeaways.rationale: Washington's rare size-speed profile and immediate contingency role behind an injured Ashton Jeanty offer feature-back upside at a near-free price.
risks: The role can disappear once Jeanty is healthy.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Marks is earning third-down and receiving work in a backfield that may be much closer to a split than his price implies.
takeaways.rationale: Marks is earning third-down and receiving work in a backfield that may be much closer to a split than his price implies.
risks: David Montgomery still projects to control early downs and goal-line work.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Kelce's declining touchdown output and broader target competition make his name value more expensive than younger late-round alternatives.
takeaways.rationale: Kelce's declining touchdown output and broader target competition make his name value more expensive than younger late-round alternatives.
risks: He still led Kansas City in receiving and retains strong chemistry with Mahomes.
